[00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:06.000]   useful video starts with a clear story, frame lab brings your recordings, notes, and screenshots
[00:00:06.000 --> 00:00:12.240]   into one place. Start by organizing the material you actually need, so every scene has a purpose.
[00:00:12.240 --> 00:00:18.000]   Next, review the cut, remove the mistakes and long pauses, then check the words that remain,
[00:00:18.000 --> 00:00:24.080]   give each visual one job, highlight a decision, explain a change, or show the product in action.
[00:00:24.080 --> 00:00:30.160]   Finally, deliver a video that is easy to revise, keep the narration clear, the captions readable,
[00:00:30.160 --> 00:00:35.920]   and the graphics consistent, when your brand changes, update the design without rebuilding the story,
[00:00:35.920 --> 00:00:43.520]   that is the workflow we are testing today.
